changeinfo.changes: - Fixed an issue with Virtual Pro upgrades in Career mode carrying over to Pro Clubs - Added new 2014 FIFA World Cup Brazil™ content, including: - 32 qualified teams - Maracana stadium - 2 new FIFA Ultimate Team game modes with new teams, players and managers from the 2014 FIFA World Cup™ - 2 new FIFA game modes with challenges based on the 2014 FIFA World Cup™
- Fixes for win/loss tracking in FIFA Ultimate Team.

- Added fixes to broadcast camera. - Improved stability when connecting to matches and accessing menus. - Improved gifting in EA SPORTS Football Club. - Fixed celebration for FA Cup final. - Ensured gamers can only play Online Friendlies and Co-Op Seasons with their friends.
- Improved stability when connecting to matches and accessing menus. - Improved stability in FIFA Ultimate Team.

- Added a fix to the Dynamic Camera option in gameplay. - Fixed issues with specific Trophy rewards when requirements are met: Silver Lining, Skills Pay The Bills, On My Own and So Skilled. - Added a fix for a rare flow issue at a Throw In. - Fixed issues with EAS FC News & Alerts for Ultimate Team and Co-Op Seasons events.
